besluite.rede: A mid-sentence 'daarom' is natural Afrikaans and already links to the sentence before; fronting it is a lateral reorder.

The commas turn two joined places (the south-west and the west coast north of it) into an apposition describing the south-west part, which moves the geography; the original parses correctly without them.
'Die patrone wys' is acceptable Afrikaans and the proposal is longer for a Grade 5 reader without being clearly better; it is a lateral move.
